Preference isn't proof.

Sole source, single source and competition in government contractor purchasing.

Choose a scenario to watch.

What this training covers

A requested supplier, a proprietary product, a stack of quotations, a sole-source justification: each raises the same question about competition. Four short, narrated scenarios show how market research, supporting evidence and comparable quotations answer it, and why the price needs its own support even when the source is justified.

Illustrative only: examples, not benchmarks. Actual requirements depend on the contracts, regulations and company procedures.
